_doc: Every axis is scored 1-10. `machine` axes are computed from the render (scripts/machine_scores.py). `vision` axes are scored by the reviewing agent after LOOKING at the sheets (references/review-protocol.md). Anchors say what a 2 / 5 / 8 / 10 looks like so scores stay comparable across reviewers and models.

hook.title: Hook speed
hook.question: How soon does the first real change (a morph, cut or big move, not an idle pulse) start?

dead_time.title: No dead stretches
dead_time.question: Longest run with almost nothing changing on screen.

variety.title: New thing every 2-4 s
variety.question: Longest gap between real events (start, events, end).

loop_seam.title: Loop seam
loop_seam.question: Last frame -> first frame vs ordinary frame steps (only when the profile says the film loops).

beat_alive.title: Every beat alive
beat_alive.question: Share of beats with visible change (only when a bpm is given).

audio.title: Audio numbers
audio.question: video-critique audio checks: levels, density, opening, loudness (skipped for silent films). Says nothing about taste: never heard by the machine.

first_2s.title: First 2 seconds
first_2s.question: Look at hook.png. Is the first frame striking and clear, and is the value or the action visible within 2 s?

anchors.2: empty or a logo sitting still
anchors.5: clear but generic, could be any product
anchors.8: specific and moving, the viewer knows what this is

phone_readability.title: Phone readability
phone_readability.question: Look at phone.png (360 px wide). Can the primary text and numbers be read at a glance? Note anything under about 10 px tall at that size.

anchors.5: readable but small or low contrast in places
anchors.8: all primary text clear, only decoration is small

motion_quality.title: Motion quality
motion_quality.question: Look at strip-*.png. Do things ease with mass, arrive together, avoid overlaps, pops and sliding, and does blur only appear on motion?

composition.title: Composition
composition.question: Look at contact.png. Balance, use of the frame, safe zones, dead space, hierarchy.

anchors.5: fine but lots of dead space or crowded

brand_accuracy.title: Brand accuracy
brand_accuracy.question: Do palette, type, tone, UI and copy match this brand (not a previous video, not a generic default)? Are invented numbers labelled?

anchors.10: indistinguishable from the brand's own team

message_clarity.title: Message clarity
message_clarity.question: After one watch, could a stranger say what the product does / what to do next? Is the ask or payoff visible?

anchors.5: gets the topic, not the value
anchors.8: value and next step are clear
anchors.10: the value lands in one sentence
